fact: ARICEA's own presentation names Sudan as a member of the Executive Committee of the Association of Regulators of Information and Communications for Eastern and Southern Africa, launched January 2003 under COMESA; the document gives no date for Sudan joining, so the published date is used.

ARICEA states that Sudan, with Burundi and Zimbabwe (Broadcasting Authority), held a member seat on its five-seat Executive Committee, alongside Ethiopia (Chairman) and Uganda (Vice Chairman); the document gives no date for winning the seat, so the published date is used.

Sudan is listed among the 49 countries that signed the Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence, done at Kigali on 4 April 2025 with the African Union and Smart Africa as institutional signatories.
The ATU reports that the country is among 23 states that have endorsed the 49 African Common Proposals for the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference 2026.
